title: TMSEvent
description: Standard event payload emitted by the TMS Desktop Agent and ingested by the Backend

associate_id.description: Employee ID of the associate (e.g. EMP101)

session_id.description: Unique session UUID for the current work shift (e.g. sess-abc-001)

claim_id.description: Identifier of the active claim (e.g. CLM1003) or empty string / UNASSIGNED if none

event_type.description: Classification of the emitted agent event

app_name.description: Canonical name of the application in focus (e.g. Excel, Chrome, ClaimPlatform)

window_title.description: Sanitized active window title captured from OS

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event creation

is_idle.description: Flag indicating if the user is currently idle (no keyboard/mouse input > threshold)
